elements.label: Outgoing CTA text replaced by logo card
elements.text: Try Notion AI for free at Notion.com

pattern.description: The CTA end card hard-cuts to a centred Notion AI face mascot in a circle on a soft grey background; the face then animates its expression (brow lifts, eye squints into a wink) in hand-drawn, stepped frames.
pattern.why_premium: Ending on a character beat gives the brand mark personality: a held-frame, on-twos expression change reads as hand-crafted illustration rather than a generic logo fade, and the hard cut keeps the ending crisp.

build_hint.gsap: tl.set('.cta', {autoAlpha: 0}).set('.logo', {autoAlpha: 1}); then swap mascot pose frames with a stepped tween: tl.to('.mascot-frames', {backgroundPositionX: '-=N*w', duration: 0.4, ease: 'steps(5)'}) (or tl.set each pose layer every 2 frames).
build_hint.remotion: Use a <Sequence> hard cut from the CTA to the logo; inside, pick the mascot pose with Math.floor(frame / 2) % poses.length (animating on twos) for about 12 frames, then hold the final wink pose.

notes: Burst starts with a single-frame hard cut (energy spike at frame 8 of the burst) from the CTA text to the logo, followed by alternating-frame small spikes = expression animated on twos. b02 and b01 are diff boxes that include the vanished CTA text area; b03-b07 are residual glyph diffs of the old text and are not listed separately. The cut might be better treated as a shot transition (hard_cut) rather than an element change.
